HediffDef.label: living forge incubation
HediffDef.description: A Living Forge is growing through this host's tissues. The one-day gestation heavily incapacitates the host. If the host survives to maturity, the host is killed, the incubation is removed from the resulting corpse, and a minified Living Forge emerges nearby. Death before maturity destroys the immature implant.
